walking.foregroundOnly.en: Foreground walking guidance. Location permission must already be enabled; leaving the app pauses navigation.
walking.foregroundOnly.zh-Hans: 仅在前台提供步行指引；需要已授权定位，离开 App 将暂停导航

walking.previewUnavailable.en: Walking route unavailable. No walkable path has been verified.
walking.previewUnavailable.zh-Hans: 步行路线不可用，尚未确认可通行道路

walking.offlineFixture.en: Synthetic route preview; map network disabled
walking.offlineFixture.zh-Hans: 合成路线演示，地图网络已禁用

walking.estimateNotice.en: Progress and remaining time are approximate. Follow signs and actual road conditions.
walking.estimateNotice.zh-Hans: 进度与剩余时间为估计，请遵循现场标识和实际路况

walking.arrivalBoundary.en: Being near the destination does not complete a task or grant rewards. Return to the current task to verify it.
walking.arrivalBoundary.zh-Hans: 接近目的地不会完成任务或发放奖励，请返回当前任务进行验证

walking.resume.en: Resume / retry with a fresh route

walking.safety.en: Check crossings, closures and building entrances. No indoor, background or voice guidance is provided.
walking.safety.zh-Hans: 注意路口、封路与建筑入口；当前不提供室内、后台或语音指引

walking.ready.en: Ready to request the current allowed destination
walking.ready.zh-Hans: 等待获取当前允许导航的目的地

walking.nearDestination.en: Near the destination; verification is still required
walking.nearDestination.zh-Hans: 已接近目的地，仍需进行任务验证

walking.paused.en: Navigation paused; resuming refreshes the destination and route
walking.paused.zh-Hans: 导航已暂停；继续时重新获取目的地和路线

walking.error.unavailable.en: Walking navigation is not enabled for this account and environment.
walking.error.unavailable.zh-Hans: 当前账号与环境尚未启用步行导航

walking.error.targetUnavailable.en: This destination is no longer available. Refresh the current task.
walking.error.targetUnavailable.zh-Hans: 当前目的地不可用，请刷新当前任务

walking.error.coordinateUnsupported.en: This coordinate and map-provider combination has not been verified.
walking.error.coordinateUnsupported.zh-Hans: 此坐标基准与地图供应商组合尚未验证

walking.error.permissionRequired.en: Location permission has not been granted. Enable it through the separate location-permission flow.
walking.error.permissionRequired.zh-Hans: 尚未授权定位，请通过独立定位授权流程开启

walking.error.permissionDenied.en: Location permission is denied. You can change it in system settings.
walking.error.permissionDenied.zh-Hans: 定位权限被拒绝，可在系统设置中修改

walking.error.weakGPS.en: Location is inaccurate or outdated. Wait in a safe open area and retry.
walking.error.weakGPS.zh-Hans: 定位精度不足或已过期，请在安全开阔处等待后重试

walking.error.network.en: The route service is unavailable. A cached or straight-line route will not be used.
walking.error.network.zh-Hans: 路线服务暂不可用，不会用缓存路线或直线代替

walking.error.throttled.en: Route requests are cooling down. Wait before retrying.
walking.error.throttled.zh-Hans: 路线请求冷却中，请稍后重试

walking.error.staleContext.en: Your session changed. Reopen navigation from the current account.
walking.error.staleContext.zh-Hans: 登录状态已变化，请从当前账号重新打开导航

walking.error.replanLimit.en: Automatic replanning limit reached. Pause safely and request a new route.
walking.error.replanLimit.zh-Hans: 已达到自动重新规划上限，请安全停步后重新获取路线

walking.mapPending.en: Your walking route will appear here
